statement: ¬ (let w := fun k : ℕ => if Nat.Prime k then Real.log (k:ℝ) else 0; let E := fun x : ℝ => Complex.exp (((2*Real.pi*x:ℝ):ℂ)*Complex.I); let S := fun (n : ℕ) (w : ℕ → ℝ) (t : ℝ) => Finset.sum (Finset.range (n+1)) (fun k => (w k:ℂ)*E ((k:ℝ)*t)); let Q := fun n : ℕ => (Nat.log 2 (n+2))^2; let f := fun (n : ℕ) (t : ℝ) => (S n w t)^2*E (-(n:ℝ)*t); let A := fun (n : ℕ) (r : ℕ → ℕ → ℝ) => {t : ℝ | ∃ q a : ℕ, 1 ≤ q ∧ q ≤ Q n ∧ a ≤ q ∧ Nat.Coprime a q ∧ |t-(a:ℝ)/(q:ℝ)| ≤ r q a * (Q n:ℝ)/((q:ℝ)*(n:ℝ))}; let M := fun (n : ℕ) (r : ℕ → ℕ → ℝ) => (intervalIntegral (fun t => (A n r).indicator (f n) t) (0:ℝ) 1 MeasureTheory.volume).re; ∃ N : ℕ, ∀ n ≥ N, Even n → ∀ r : ℕ → ℝ, (∀ q, (1/2:ℝ) ≤ r q ∧ r q ≤ 2) → (n:ℝ) ≤ M n (fun q _ => r q))

plain_statement.zh: 证伪：逐分母调宽后仍有 n 主弧下界
plain_statement.en: Refute: A uniform n floor under denominator-dependent dilation

brief.zh: 每个分母独立选择半倍至两倍半径，同分母各分子共用。尝试先合并 Ramanujan 系数，再估计失去单调性的分母权。 请证明冻结命题的完整否定；单个小规模算例不足。
brief.en: Keep a common radius per denominator, between half and twice its original value. Sum Ramanujan coefficients first and control the loss of monotonicity. Prove the full negation, beyond a single finite example.
